newsitem.title: USA: FNB to acquire West Coast Bancorp for $31 million.
newsitem.headline: FNB to acquire West Coast Bancorp for $31 million.

text.p: FNB Corp. will acquire West Coast Bancorp Inc., another Florida-based banking company, in a deal worth about $31 million, the companies said Friday.
Under the definitive agreement, FNB will offer 0.794 share of its stock for each West Coast share, or a total of 1.3 million FNB shares, in a tax-free exchange.
West Coast shareholders will receive increased cash dividends of about 13 cents a share over the next two quarters, FNB said.
Hermitage, Pa.-based FNB, the parent of First National Bank & Trust Co., said the consideration received by West Coast shareholders will total $18.88 per share.
Cape Coral, Fla.-based West Coast will be merged into Southwest Banks Inc., a future subsidiary of FNB.
West Coast's stock rose $1 to $17 in early trading on the Nasdaq market while FNB, which closed Thursday at $24, did not immediately begin trading on Nasdaq.
